title: Mission: The Alligator
subtitle: Meet a powerful reptile built for life near water.
summary: Explore an animated alligator, identify its body parts, and discover how it moves.
activityInstruction: Try all four movements, scratch to reveal body parts, then rearrange the alligator picture.
exploreInstruction: Rotate and zoom the 3D alligator to view it from every side.

storyQuestions.prompt: Where do alligators spend much of their time?
storyQuestions.success: Alligators live in and near fresh water such as swamps, lakes, and rivers.

storyQuestions.prompt: Why are an alligator's eyes and nostrils high on its head?
answers: So it can see and breathe while mostly underwater
storyQuestions.success: Its high eyes and nostrils help it watch and breathe while staying low in the water.
The strong tail pushes the alligator through the water.

quiz.success: Tough scales help protect an alligator's body.

quiz.prompt: Which body part pushes an alligator through water?
quiz.success: The muscular tail helps an alligator swim.

quiz.prompt: What kind of animal is an alligator?

parts.label: Scaled Body
parts.fact: Tough scales protect the alligator like natural armor.
parts.help: Select the large middle part of the alligator.

parts.label: Head
parts.fact: Eyes and nostrils high on the head help the alligator watch and breathe in water.

parts.label: Teeth
parts.fact: Sharp teeth grip food when the strong jaws snap shut.
parts.help: Select the teeth inside the mouth.

parts.label: Legs
parts.fact: Four short, strong legs carry the alligator across land.
parts.help: Select one of the four legs.

parts.label: Strong Tail
parts.fact: The muscular tail pushes the alligator through water.
parts.help: Select the long tail behind the body.
